beats.text: To recap. Balance combustion in the order carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, and remember oxygen already in the fuel. Write incomplete combustion only when the products are specified. Use states that match the conditions, and separate what a reaction formed from what is measured after cooling.
Closing recall. Balance the complete combustion of propane, C three H eight.

Three carbons give three carbon dioxide. Eight hydrogens give four water. That's ten oxygen atoms in the products, so five oxygen molecules. Propane plus five oxygen forms three carbon dioxide plus four water. Next episode: what happens when one reactant runs out first.
